tools.name: get_leaderboard
tools.description: Models ranked by accuracy; defaults to all effort levels for compatibility.

tools.name: list_providers
tools.description: Provider ids, names, families and variant counts.

tools.name: list_families
tools.description: Model families, available efforts and best variants.

tools.name: compare_models
tools.description: Side-by-side core overall and per-size accuracy, cost, latency and token results for model or family names.

tools.name: get_model_results
tools.description: Accuracy, cost, latency and token use for one model, broken down by grid size.

tools.name: list_puzzles
tools.description: The benchmark puzzles with their ids and row/column clues.

tools.name: get_puzzle
tools.description: One puzzle, including the clue text models were prompted with. The reference solution is only included on request; some puzzles have several valid solutions.

tools.name: check_solution
tools.description: Check a grid against a puzzle's clues, using the same rule as the benchmark grader. Reports which rows and columns do not match.

tools.name: get_puzzle_results
tools.description: Per-model outcomes for one puzzle. Answers are omitted unless requested.

tools.name: get_model_puzzles
tools.description: Which puzzles one model solved, missed, timed out on, or has not run.

tools.name: list_runs
tools.description: Individual benchmark runs (one model on one puzzle), optionally with the raw prompt and model output.
